en.summary: Fixes TCU width adaptation by preserving XLEN-wide source rows until lane extraction and by sign-extending the 32-bit tensor result on writeback.
why_it_counts: The patch corrects real datapath width behavior in the tensor core execution unit.
It changes operand slicing and architectural writeback, not tests or formatting.
The bug directly affects tensor results on designs where the architectural register width is wider than 32 bits.
evidence: a_row and b_col change from 32-bit element arrays to XLEN-wide element arrays.
The per-element buffer extraction is changed to explicitly slice from a_row[k][31:0] and b_col[k][31:0] only at the lane-extraction point.
The writeback path changes from assigning d_val directly to assigning XLEN'($signed(d_val[i][j])).

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A tensor datapath often computes on 32-bit lane values while the architectural source and destination registers are XLEN-wide. If the implementation truncates the register payload too early, or fails to sign-extend the 32-bit accumulated result back to the architectural width, tensor operations can produce wrong values when interfacing with wider register files.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: width adaptation between XLEN-wide register storage and 32-bit tensor lanes
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Any tensor or matrix operation that sources data from registers wider than the native tensor lane width, or writes a signed 32-bit result back into a wider architectural register.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Truncate source rows to 32 bits before the final lane-selection point, or write the 32-bit tensor result back without explicit sign extension.
portability_notes: This is most relevant on DUTs with 64-bit architectural registers feeding 32-bit tensor sublanes.
You can inject either the source-side truncation bug, the result-side sign-extension bug, or both together.
Keep the tensor arithmetic core unchanged so the failure comes only from width adaptation at the interface.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the stage that reinterprets architectural source registers as per-lane tensor elements.
Force those source rows into 32-bit containers before the element-selection logic instead of preserving the full architectural width up to the extraction point.
At writeback, assign the raw 32-bit result into the wider destination register without signed extension.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_tcu_core source-row width handling and result_if writeback
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix keeps a_row and b_col at XLEN width until 32-bit lane extraction and sign-extends d_val on result writeback.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert a_row and b_col to 32-bit declarations fed by 32'(rs*_data[..][31:0]) and revert result_if.data.data assignment to the raw d_val value.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Tensor operations can read the wrong sublane bits or return improperly extended results, producing incorrect matrix outputs on wider-register configurations.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, a_row and b_col were declared as 32-bit elements and fed through 32-bit casts.
Before the fix, writeback assigned d_val directly without XLEN sign extension.
The arithmetic result array d_val remains 32-bit in both versions; the bug is in interface width adaptation.
notes: A source-side truncation-only mutation is usually enough to recreate a functional failure.
The writeback sign-extension bug is especially visible when negative 32-bit results are observed through a wider architectural register.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 TCU 的宽度适配问题，使源操作数行在元素提取前保持 XLEN 宽度，并在写回时对 32 位张量结果进行符号扩展。
why_it_counts: 补丁修正了张量核心执行单元中的真实数据通路宽度行为。
它修改的是操作数切片和体系结构写回，而不是测试或格式整理。
在体系结构寄存器宽度大于 32 位的设计上，这个缺陷会直接影响张量计算结果。
evidence: a_row 和 b_col 从 32 位元素数组改成了 XLEN 位元素数组。
逐元素缓冲提取逻辑改为只在最终 lane 提取点上显式使用 a_row[k][31:0] 和 b_col[k][31:0] 进行切片。
写回路径从直接赋值 d_val 改成了 XLEN'($signed(d_val[i][j]))。
该提交没有修改任何非 DUT 文件。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 张量数据通路通常在 32 位 lane 上计算，但其体系结构源寄存器和目的寄存器是 XLEN 位宽。如果实现过早把寄存器载荷截断到 32 位，或者没有在写回时把 32 位累加结果符号扩展回体系结构宽度，那么在更宽寄存器文件接口上就会产生错误结果。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: XLEN 宽寄存器存储与 32 位张量 lane 之间的宽度适配
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 任何从宽于原生张量 lane 的寄存器中取数，或把有符号 32 位结果写回到更宽目的寄存器的张量/矩阵操作。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在最终 lane 选择之前就把源操作数行截成 32 位，或者在写回时不做显式符号扩展而直接写入 32 位张量结果。
portability_notes: 该缺陷尤其适用于使用 64 位体系结构寄存器承载 32 位张量子 lane 的 DUT。
可以只注入源侧截断缺陷，只注入结果侧符号扩展缺陷，或两者一起注入。
保持张量算术核心不变，使故障仅来自接口宽度适配。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把体系结构源寄存器重新解释为逐 lane 张量元素的阶段。
在元素选择逻辑之前，就把这些源行强制放入 32 位容器，而不是一直保留完整体系结构宽度直到提取点。
在写回阶段，把原始 32 位结果直接赋给更宽的目的寄存器，不做有符号扩展。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_tcu_core 中源操作数行的宽度处理和 result_if 写回逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复让 a_row 和 b_col 在 32 位 lane 提取之前保持 XLEN 宽度，并在结果写回时对 d_val 做符号扩展。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 a_row 和 b_col 改回由 32'(rs*_data[..][31:0]) 驱动的 32 位声明，并把 result_if.data.data 的赋值改回原始 d_val。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 张量操作可能读取到错误的子 lane 位，或者把结果以错误扩展方式写回，从而在宽寄存器配置上产生错误矩阵输出。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，a_row 和 b_col 被声明为 32 位元素，并通过 32 位强制转换获得。
修复前，写回路径直接赋值 d_val，没有进行 XLEN 符号扩展。
两个版本里的算术结果数组 d_val 都保持 32 位，因此缺陷位于接口宽度适配层。
notes: 仅注入源侧截断通常就足以复现功能错误。
当负的 32 位结果通过更宽体系结构寄存器观察时，写回符号扩展缺陷会尤其明显。
